title: Dryer Six
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: Dryer six was running. I hadn't put anything in.
first_visual: Extreme close-up of a round dryer porthole, dark tumbling inside, a rust-red sock slapping the glass.

beats.visual: ECU porthole: dark tumbling, a rust-red sock slaps the glass.
beats.vo: Dryer six was running. I hadn't put anything in.

beats.visual: Wide: Ivy alone with her basket; dryer six turning on its own.
The door pops; a small sock drops; name tag reads IVY M. (tag text in post).
beats.vo: It gave me a sock. Mine. From when I was seven.

beats.visual: Items tumble out one by one onto the tile: hair clip, wristband, badge.
Last item: a rust scarf. Ivy touches her bare neck.
beats.vo: Then my scarf. The one I was wearing.

beats.visual: Reverse angle from inside the drum: Ivy's palms on the glass; outside, a woman in the scarf folds Ivy's clothes.
beats.vo: I looked up. Through the glass.

beats.visual: The double smiles and turns the dial; drum spins; moth on the lint-filter sign.
beats.vo: She folds better than I do.

ending: The double sets the dial; the drum starts again. Ivy is the lost thing dryer six kept.
loop_note: Yes. The last frame (porthole spinning, seen from outside) matches frame 1, and on a rewatch the opening slap reads as Ivy hitting the glass.

originality_review: Original. 'Lost property returned' plus a camera-side swap is our own construction. No known creator story uses a laundromat dryer as the agent of replacement. The twist differs from MW005 (counting) and MW010 (phone reflection).
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: Alone in a 24-hour laundromat, a woman watches an empty dryer return everything she has ever lost, until it returns the scarf she is wearing and she realises which side of the glass she is on.

hooks.line: Dryer six was running. I hadn't put anything in.
hooks.first_visual: Extreme close-up of a round dryer porthole, dark tumbling inside, a rust-red sock slapping the glass.

hooks.line: Why does dryer six only return things I lost?
hooks.first_visual: A child's sock with a faded name tag dropping out of a dryer onto tile.

hooks.line: At three a.m. a dryer gave me back my childhood.
hooks.first_visual: A hair clip, a wristband and a birthday badge spilling across a folding table.

hooks.line: The laundromat was empty. Dryer six wasn't.
hooks.first_visual: Wide shot: a row of dark dryers, one porthole glowing and turning.

hooks.line: Look closely at the glass. Who is inside?
hooks.first_visual: A porthole reflecting a woman's face, slightly out of sync with her.

setting: Suds & Spin laundromat at 3 a.m.; one row of dryers; folding table; warm, buzzing tubes.
conflict: Ivy wants to know why an empty machine is running and what it is giving back.
escalation: A sock from age seven, then a hair clip, a hospital wristband, then the scarf from her own neck.
reveal: The camera reverses: we are inside the drum with Ivy. Outside, a woman in her scarf folds her laundry.
emotional_objective: Curiosity curdling into the cold loss of self.
